description: Local bridge between TikTok Live (username-only, no password) and a Minecraft Bedrock server addon. Aternos variant: bridge can run on Render (public URL), addon polls GET /events. bot.js is in ../bot/ and is a SEPARATE, UNTESTED fallback — it is NOT installed with this bridge, because bedrock-protocol failed to build on Node 24 in testing (raknet-native cmake-js error).
name: tiktok-bedrock-bridge
